ns2:section.sectionText: Discovering Performing Arts Technology. Students will be exposed to many of the technologies and processes used in mounting a production throughout the world. It is hoped that through this course students will develop an appreciation and understanding of the role of technology in theatrical production and will be exposed to theatre technology as a career path worthy of consideration. The instructor will attempt to show how the work in the USA parallels or differs with work in other countries. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
